title: Employer Unemployment Insurance Tax Accounts: Penalty and Interest Schedule
content:
The figures that govern late report penalties, late payment interest, abatement and delinquency on Employer Unemployment Insurance Tax Accounts are fixed per financing class as follows. Every class carries the same penalty figures; late payment interest is 0.01 a month in every class except Reimbursing — Governmental Entity, which is charged no interest.

## Penalty figures

| Financing class | Flat late report penalty (USD) | Late report percentage of the quarter's total wages | Late report penalty maximum (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Contributory — New Employer Standard Rate | 50.00 | 0.001 (0.1%) | 250.00 |
| Contributory — New Employer Construction Rate | 50.00 | 0.001 (0.1%) | 250.00 |
| Contributory — Experience-Rated Positive Reserve | 50.00 | 0.001 (0.1%) | 250.00 |
| Contributory — Experience-Rated Deficit Reserve | 50.00 | 0.001 (0.1%) | 250.00 |
| Contributory — Delinquent Reporting Assigned Rate | 50.00 | 0.001 (0.1%) | 250.00 |
| Reimbursing — Nonprofit Organization | 50.00 | 0.001 (0.1%) | 250.00 |
| Reimbursing — Governmental Entity | 50.00 | 0.001 (0.1%) | 250.00 |

## Interest, abatement and delinquency figures

| Financing class | Monthly late payment interest rate | Part month counts as | Penalty abatement lookback (quarters) | Abatement request window (calendar days) | Interest may be abated | Delinquency after (calendar days past due date) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Contributory — New Employer Standard Rate | 0.01 (1%) | A full month | 8 | 30 | No | 30 |
| Contributory — New Employer Construction Rate | 0.01 (1%) | A full month | 8 | 30 | No | 30 |
| Contributory — Experience-Rated Positive Reserve | 0.01 (1%) | A full month | 8 | 30 | No | 30 |
| Contributory — Experience-Rated Deficit Reserve | 0.01 (1%) | A full month | 8 | 30 | No | 30 |
| Contributory — Delinquent Reporting Assigned Rate | 0.01 (1%) | A full month | 8 | 30 | No | 30 |
| Reimbursing — Nonprofit Organization | 0.01 (1%) | A full month | 8 | 30 | No | 30 |
| Reimbursing — Governmental Entity | 0 | A full month | 8 | 30 | No | 30 |

## Meaning of each figure

- **Flat late report penalty** — the minimum penalty for a report filed after its due date.
- **Late report percentage** — the late report penalty as a share of the quarter's total wages, where that is larger than the flat amount.
- **Late report penalty maximum** — the cap on the late report penalty per report.
- **Monthly late payment interest rate** — interest for each month or part of a month on contributions or reimbursement bills unpaid after the due date.
- **Part month counts as** — any part of a month of lateness counts as a full month.
- **Penalty abatement lookback** — the quarters before the late quarter that must be free of other late reports for a first-time abatement: 8 quarters.
- **Abatement request window** — the calendar days after the penalty assessment within which abatement must be requested.
- **Interest may be abated** — "No" in every class.
- **Delinquency after** — the calendar days after the due date, with a report unfiled or a balance unpaid, before the account is delinquent.

**Part-month illustration (hypothetical).** A balance unpaid for one month and three days counts as two months of lateness, because the three days are a part month counted in full.
